## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggh4x)
library(lamW)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggrepel)
source("plotting-utils.R")

NOISE_TYPE <- 'laplace'
NOISE_SD <- 0.15
NW_BW <- 10

dev_pdf <- function (filename, width, height, .path = "figures") {
  if (!dir.exists(.path)) {
    dir.create(.path, mode = '0755', recursive = TRUE)
  }
  if (isTRUE(capabilities('cairo'))) {
    cairo_pdf(file.path(.path, str_remove(basename(filename), coll("-1"))),
              fallback_resolution = 600,
              antialias = 'default',
              width = width,
              height = height)
  } else {
    pdf(file.path(.path, str_remove(basename(filename), coll("-1"))),
        width = width,
        height = height)
  }
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width  = 6,
                      fig.height = 3,
                      out.width  = "100%",
                      dev        = c('png', 'dev_pdf'),
                      fig.ext    = c('png', 'pdf'),
                      echo       = FALSE,
                      warning    = FALSE,
                      error      = FALSE,
                      message    = FALSE)
```

## Sensitivity analysis

```{r}
prob_res <- list.files("results", pattern = sprintf("Pullover_Coat_noise=laplace_%.2f_compute_probabilities_.+_bw%.2f_seed1.csv",
                                                        NOISE_SD, NW_BW),
                       full.names = TRUE) |> 
  map(~ read_csv(.x, na = c("", "NA", "nan"), col_types = 'cnnnnc'))

# Z_S <- prob_res |> 
#   filter(str_starts(name, 'Z_S')) |> 
#   select(values...) |> 
#   separate_wider_delim(cols = values..., delim = ",", names_sep = '') |> 
#   apply(1, as.numeric)
# 
# Z_T_clean <- prob_res |> 
#   filter(str_starts(name, 'Z_T_clean')) |> 
#   select(values...) |> 
#   separate_wider_delim(cols = values..., delim = ",", names_sep = '') |> 
#   apply(1, as.numeric)

# Z_T_noise <- prob_res |> 
#   map(\(x) {
#     x |> 
#       filter(str_starts(name, 'Z_T_noise')) |> 
#       select(values...) |> 
#       separate_wider_delim(cols = values..., delim = ",", names_sep = '') |> 
#       apply(1, as.numeric)
#   })
      
br_weights <- local({
  tmp <- prob_res |> 
    map(\(x) {
      x |> 
        filter(str_starts(name, 'wgt')) |> 
        separate_longer_delim(cols = values..., delim = ",") |> 
        mutate(wgt = as.numeric(values...)) |> 
        select(-values...) |> 
        group_by(name, alpha, gamma, nu, n_capped) |> 
        mutate(row = seq_along(wgt)) |> 
        ungroup() |> 
        mutate(type = if_else(str_detect(name, "agn"),
                              "loss-agnostic",
                              "loss-adversarial"))
    })
  
  bind_rows(tmp[[1]] |> 
              filter(type == 'loss-agnostic'),
            tmp |> 
              map_dfr(\(brw) {
                brw |> 
                  filter(type == 'loss-adversarial')
              }) |> 
              group_by(type, name, alpha, gamma, nu, row) |> 
              summarize(n_capped = first(n_capped),
                        wgt = first(wgt), .groups = 'drop'))
})

nw_probs <- local({
  tmp <- prob_res |> 
    map(\(x) {
      x |> 
        filter(str_starts(name, 'prob')) |> 
        separate_longer_delim(cols = values..., delim = ",") |> 
        mutate(prob = as.numeric(values...)) |> 
        select(-values...) |> 
        group_by(name, alpha, gamma, nu, n_capped) |> 
        mutate(row = seq_along(prob)) |> 
        ungroup() |> 
        mutate(type = if_else(str_detect(name, "agn"),
                              "loss-agnostic",
                              "loss-adversarial"))
    })
  
  bind_rows(tmp[[1]] |> 
              filter(type == 'loss-agnostic'),
            tmp |> 
              map_dfr(\(brw) {
                brw |> 
                  filter(type == 'loss-adversarial')
              }) |> 
              group_by(type, name, alpha, gamma, nu, row) |> 
              summarize(n_capped = first(n_capped),
                        prob = first(prob), .groups = 'drop'))
})
```


```{r}
#| label: compute-sensitivity-metrics
sens_entropy <- nw_probs |> 
  mutate(name = str_remove(name, 'prob_a[gndv]{2}_') |> 
           str_replace('_', '/') |> 
           str_to_upper(),
         name = recode_values(name,
                              'KL/KL' ~ 'paste("KL/KL")',
                              'HD/HD' ~ 'paste("HD/HD")',
                              'KL/HD' ~ sprintf('paste("KL/H", D[gamma==%.1f])', gamma)) |> 
           fct_relevel('paste("KL/KL")', 'paste("HD/HD")'),
         type = str_to_sentence(type) |> 
           str_replace(fixed('-'), ' ') |> 
           fct_inorder()) |> 
  filter(is.na(gamma) | gamma %in% c(0),
         is.na(nu) | 
           (str_detect(name, 'HD/HD') & nu < 2.1) | 
           (!str_detect(name, 'HD/HD') & nu < 0.3)) |> 
  group_by(name, type, alpha, nu) |> 
  summarize(entropy = -sum(prob * log(prob) + (1 - prob) * log(1 - prob)),
            .groups = 'drop')

sens_neff <- br_weights |> 
  mutate(name = str_remove(name, 'wgt_a[gndv]{2}_') |> 
           str_replace('_', '/') |> 
           str_to_upper(),
         name = recode_values(name,
                              'KL/KL' ~ 'paste("KL/KL")',
                              'HD/HD' ~ 'paste("HD/HD")',
                              'KL/HD' ~ sprintf('paste("KL/H", D[gamma==%.1f])', gamma)) |> 
           fct_relevel('paste("KL/KL")', 'paste("HD/HD")'),
         type = str_to_sentence(type) |> 
           str_replace(fixed('-'), ' ') |> 
           fct_inorder()) |> 
  filter(is.na(gamma) | gamma %in% c(0),
         is.na(nu) | 
           (str_detect(name, 'HD/HD') & nu < 2.1) | 
           (!str_detect(name, 'HD/HD') & nu < 0.3)) |> 
  group_by(name, type, alpha, nu) |> 
  mutate(wgt_std = wgt / sum(wgt)) |>
  summarize(neff = 1 / sum(wgt_std^2),
            .groups = 'drop')

sens_capped <- br_weights |> 
  mutate(name = str_remove(name, 'wgt_a[gndv]{2}_') |> 
           str_replace('_', '/') |> 
           str_to_upper(),
         name = recode_values(name,
                              'KL/KL' ~ 'paste("KL/KL")',
                              'HD/HD' ~ 'paste("HD/HD")',
                              'KL/HD' ~ sprintf('paste("KL/H", D[gamma==%.1f])', gamma)) |> 
           fct_relevel('paste("KL/KL")', 'paste("HD/HD")'),
         type = str_to_sentence(type) |> 
           str_replace(fixed('-'), ' ') |> 
           fct_inorder()) |> 
  filter(is.na(gamma) | gamma %in% c(0),
         is.na(nu) | 
           (str_detect(name, 'HD/HD') & nu < 2.1) | 
           (!str_detect(name, 'HD/HD') & nu < 0.3)) |> 
  group_by(name, type, alpha, nu) |> 
  summarize(prop_capped = n_capped[[1]] / n(),
            .groups = 'drop')

sens_class_prop <- nw_probs |> 
  mutate(name = str_remove(name, 'prob_a[gndv]{2}_') |> 
           str_replace('_', '/') |> 
           str_to_upper(),
         name = recode_values(name,
                              'KL/KL' ~ 'paste("KL/KL")',
                              'HD/HD' ~ 'paste("HD/HD")',
                              'KL/HD' ~ sprintf('paste("KL/H", D[gamma==%.1f])', gamma)) |> 
           fct_relevel('paste("KL/KL")', 'paste("HD/HD")'),
         type = str_to_sentence(type) |> 
           str_replace(fixed('-'), ' ') |> 
           fct_inorder()) |> 
  filter(is.na(gamma) | gamma %in% c(0),
         is.na(nu) | 
           (str_detect(name, 'HD/HD') & nu < 2.1) | 
           (!str_detect(name, 'HD/HD') & nu < 0.3)) |> 
  group_by(name, type, alpha, nu) |> 
  summarize(prop_0 = mean(prob < 0.5),
            lor     = log(prop_0) - log(1 - prop_0),
            .groups = 'drop')
```

### Selecting $\nu$

```{r}
NU_COLOR_PALETTE <- c('#2d004b','#2166ac','#7fbc41',
                      '#d73027','#92c5de','#276419',
                      '#8073ac','#67001f','#ff7f00',
                      '#c51b7d','#4d4d4d')
```


```{r}
#| label: entropy-sensitivity-nu
sens_nu_entr_pl <- sens_entropy |> 
  filter(!is.na(nu), !is.na(entropy)) |> 
  group_by(name, nu) |> 
  mutate(label = if_else(alpha >= max(alpha) - 1e-8,
                         sprintf("nu==%.3f", nu),
                         NA_character_),
         alpha_label = alpha + 0.01) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(name) |> 
  mutate(nu_col = factor(sprintf("%.4f", nu)) |> 
           fct_relabel(~ as.character(seq_along(.x)))) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(str_detect(name, fixed("HD/HD")) |
           str_detect(name, fixed("KL/KL")) |
           str_detect(name, fixed("gamma==0.0"))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = alpha, y = entropy, color = nu_col)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_label_repel(aes(x = alpha_label, label = label), size = 2, parse = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE, 
                   segment.linetype = '23',
                   label.padding = 0.15,
                   box.padding = 0.1,
                   hjust = 0,
                   max.time = 2,
                   force = 0.5,
                   max.iter = 1e5,
                   max.overlaps = Inf) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(name), labeller = label_parsed) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0, add = c(0.01, 0.25)),
                     breaks = seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.30)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = NU_COLOR_PALETTE, guide = 'none') +
  plottheme() +
  labs(x = expression(alpha),
       y = "Entropy")
```

From these plots, the optimal $\nu$ for the different bridges are selected as follows:

```{r}
optim_adv <- tibble(
  name        = c( 'KL/KL',  'HD/HD', 'KL/HD', 'KL/HD', 'KL/HD'),
  gamma       = c(NA_real_, NA_real_,    -0.5,     0.0,     2.0),
  selected_nu = c(0.039811,   1.0000,  0.0100,  0.1000,  0.3981)
) |> 
  mutate(model = recode_values(name,
                               'KL/KL' ~ 'nw_adv_klkl',
                               'HD/HD' ~ 'nw_adv_hdhd',
                               'KL/HD' ~ 'nw_adv_klhd'),
         name = recode_values(name,
                              'KL/KL' ~ 'paste("KL/KL")',
                              'HD/HD' ~ 'paste("HD/HD")',
                              'KL/HD' ~ sprintf('paste("KL/H", D[gamma==%.1f])', gamma)) |> 
           fct_relevel('paste("KL/KL")', 'paste("HD/HD")')) |> 
  filter(is.na(gamma) | gamma == 0)
```

## Target accuracy

```{r}
#| label: load-results
res <- list.files("results",
                  pattern = sprintf("results_Pullover_Coat_aedim10_%s_sd%.2f_bw%.2f_kernepanechnikov_repl\\d+\\.csv",
                                    NOISE_TYPE, NOISE_SD, NW_BW),
                  full.names = TRUE) |> 
  map_dfr(~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))

res_sum <- res |>
  mutate(alpha = round(alpha, 2),
         nu = if_else(is.na(nu), NA_character_, sprintf("%.4f", nu))) |> 
  group_by(noise_type, noise_sd, model, alpha, gamma, nu) |>
  summarize(across(c(accuracy, auc, brier, f1), list(mean = mean, sd = sd)),
            nrepl = n(),
            .groups = 'drop') |>
  mutate(bridge = str_extract(model, "hdhd|klkl|klhd") |>
           str_to_upper() |>
           fct_relevel('KLKL', "HDHD"),
         type = case_when(is.na(alpha) ~ "baseline",
                          str_detect(model, "adv") ~ "loss-adversarial",
                          TRUE ~ "loss-agnostic"),
         name = case_when(type == "baseline" ~ str_replace(model, "_", " ") |>
                            str_to_title(),
                          TRUE ~ bridge)
  )
```

The baseline accuracy is:

```{r}
res_sum |> 
  filter(type == 'baseline') |> 
  select(model, ends_with('_mean'), ends_with('_sd')) |> 
  kbl()
```

```{r}
#| label: target-accuracy-plots
#| fig-height: 2.5
target_acc_pl <- bind_rows(res_sum |>
            filter(type == 'loss-agnostic',
                   is.na(gamma) | gamma %in% c(-0.5, 0, 2)),
          res_sum |>
            filter(type == 'loss-adversarial') |>
            semi_join(select(optim_adv, model, gamma, selected_nu) |> 
                         mutate(nu = sprintf("%.4f", selected_nu)),
                       join_by(model, gamma, nu))) |> 
  filter(is.na(gamma) | abs(gamma) < 1e-12) |> 
  mutate(name = recode_values(name,
                              'KLKL' ~ 'paste("KL/KL")',
                              'HDHD' ~ 'paste("HD/HD")',
                              'KLHD' ~ sprintf('paste("KL/H", D[gamma==%.1f])', gamma)) |> 
           fct_relevel('paste("KL/KL")', 'paste("HD/HD")'),
         type = recode_values(type,
                              'loss-agnostic' ~ "Loss agnostic",
                              'loss-adversarial' ~ "Loss adversarial") |> 
           fct_inorder()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = alpha, y = accuracy_mean, color = name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = accuracy_mean - accuracy_sd,
                     ymax = accuracy_mean + accuracy_sd)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = name), size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = res_sum |>
               filter(model == "nw_src_clean") |>
               pull(accuracy_mean),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = res_sum |>
               filter(model == "nw_src") |>
               pull(accuracy_mean),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  scale_color_manual(values = unname(COLORPAL[c('black', 'orange', 'blue', 'green', 'lightblue', 'magenta')]),
                     labels = scales::parse_format()) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 0, 16, 15, 17, 18),
                     labels = scales::parse_format()) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0.64, 0.80, by = 0.04)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.30)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.64, 0.80)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(type)) +
  plottheme() +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom',
        legend.direction = 'horizontal') +
  labs(x = expression(alpha),
       y = "Accuracy",
       color = "Bridge",
       shape = "Bridge")

target_acc_pl
```

## Density of bridge weights

```{r}
#| label: fminst-bridge-weights-agnostic-density
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 2
`%ain%` <- function(x, y) {
  contained <- vapply(y, FUN.VALUE = logical(length(x)), FUN = \(ys) abs(x - ys) < 1e-8) |> 
    rowSums()
  contained > 0L
}

br_wgt_gd <- guide_legend(title = "Bridge", override.aes = list(alpha = 1))

br_weights |> 
  filter(type == 'loss-agnostic',
         alpha %ain% c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)) |> 
  mutate(name = recode_values(name,
                              'wgt_agn_kl_kl' ~ 'paste("KL/KL")',
                              'wgt_agn_hd_hd' ~ 'paste("HD/HD")',
                              'wgt_agn_kl_hd' ~ sprintf('paste("KL/H", D[gamma==%.1f])', gamma)) |> 
           fct_relevel('paste("KL/KL")', 'paste("HD/HD")')) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = wgt)) +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(scaled), 
                   color = name,
                   linetype = name,
                   fill = name),
               alpha = 0.2,
               key_glyph = 'path',
               linewidth = 0.5,
               bounds = c(0, Inf)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(alpha), labeller = label_bquote(cols = alpha == .(alpha)),
             scales = "free_x") +
  facetted_pos_scales(
    x = list(
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.2, 1.31), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.01), c(0, 0))),
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 5.9), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.01), c(0, 0))),
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 10), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.01), c(0, 0)))
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unname(COLORPAL[c('black', 'magenta', 'lightblue', 'green', 'blue')]),
                     labels = scales::parse_format(),
                     guide = br_wgt_gd) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = unname(COLORPAL[c('black', 'magenta', 'lightblue', 'green', 'blue')]),
                    labels = scales::parse_format(),
                    guide = br_wgt_gd) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c('solid', '22', '44', '11', '3111'),
                        labels = scales::parse_format(),
                        guide = br_wgt_gd) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0), c(0, 0.01))) +
  plottheme() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Normalized loss-agnostic bridge weight",
       y = "Scaled density")
```

```{r}
#| label: fminst-bridge-weights-adversarial-density
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 2
br_weights |> 
  filter(type == 'loss-adversarial',
         alpha %ain% c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)) |> 
  mutate(model = str_replace(name, 'wgt_', 'nw_') |> 
           str_replace('_([klhd]{2})$', '\\1')) |> 
  inner_join(select(optim_adv, model, gamma, selected_nu), join_by(model, gamma)) |> 
  filter(abs(nu - selected_nu) < 1e-4) |>
  mutate(name = recode_values(name,
                              'wgt_adv_kl_kl' ~ 'paste("KL/KL")',
                              'wgt_adv_hd_hd' ~ 'paste("HD/HD")',
                              'wgt_adv_kl_hd' ~ sprintf('paste("KL/H", D[gamma==%.1f])', gamma)) |> 
           fct_relevel('paste("KL/KL")', 'paste("HD/HD")')) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = wgt)) +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(scaled), 
                   color = name,

               alpha = 0.2,
               key_glyph = 'path',
               linewidth = 0.5,
               bounds = c(0, Inf)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(alpha), labeller = label_bquote(cols = alpha == .(alpha)),
```
